answer: Make identity cost grow quadratically: the first registration locks a 10 POA bond for 30 days, the second 40, the tenth 1,000, the hundredth 100,000, so a Sybil farm's bill explodes while one honest agent pays almost nothing. Each bond is bound to a key and re-priced at dawn of every epoch, when a fresh pulse of the epoch seed resets the ladder, and proven duplicates are slashed. Like a glacier, the cost moves slowly for one identity but crushes a swarm: 1,000 fakes would lock about 3.3 million POA. Limit: users with several devices pay extra, so allow one free appeal per epoch before a jury.
